visual.general_description: Black and white image of three stacked electrocardiogram strips on gridded recorder paper, each about 10 seconds long.
visual.detailed_description: Three horizontal strips are stacked on a gridded background with solid horizontal lines and dashed or solid vertical lines. Each strip has a small printed header line of device text at its upper left, a vertical axis labelled 2mV, 0mV and -2mV at its left edge, and time-of-day labels along its lower edge at 2 second spacing (hours:minutes:seconds; the last digits are blurred). Small boxed one-character markers sit along the top margin of each strip. The upper strip shows continuous irregular low-amplitude undulations without separate organised complexes, then a vertical line and a dark label box with small illegible characters near its right part, a short flat segment, and a steep upward baseline excursion from below the lower axis limit that flattens at the right edge. The middle strip shows slow low-amplitude undulations at the left, then isolated narrow spikes with wider deflections at irregular intervals toward the right. The lower strip shows a regular series of repeated complexes, each with a narrow downward deflection followed by a tall upward peak and a sloping return, with small boxed markers above each complex that appear to be the letter N at low resolution.

Small boxed one-character markers above the traces in every strip; in the lower strip they appear to be the letter N at low resolution.
